transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get the pre-overtime huddle started. We need to finalize the weekend plan for 480 pump housings on Assembly Cell 8. We've got one Saturday shift and one Sunday shift, each up to 8 hours, with two operators per shift. Before I approve the final plan, I need to hear from workforce coordination, maintenance, and quality on any constraints we should be aware of. Who'd like to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I've got a constraint from workforce coordination. The current certification matrix shows that Saturday's Cell 8 roster must be Lina, who is setup-certified, and Sam, who is run-certified. Sunday's roster must be Ruth, who is setup-certified, and Omar, who is run-certified. I checked the matrix after the last training audit, but the updated roster hasn't been attached to the weekend work order yet, so we need to make sure these names are locked in.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I've got a maintenance constraint. During my morning walkaround inspection of Cell 8, I found that the conveyor servo requires a 90-minute preventive inspection between the Saturday and Sunday shifts. I recorded it in my maintenance notebook but haven't entered it in the electronic work order yet. We need to account for this downtime between shifts.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I've got a quality constraint. The customer quality amendment requires 12 first-off units after the weekend setup and 100% torque verification on the first 30 units after the maintenance restart, with quality signoff before the remaining units are released. I received the signed amendment by email, but it hasn't been linked to the order record yet, so we need to make sure that happens before production starts.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Lock in Saturday: Lina (setup-certified) and Sam (run-certified); Sunday: Ruth (setup-certified) and Omar (run-certified). Attach updated roster to the weekend work order.
Schedule the 90-minute conveyor servo preventive inspection between Saturday and Sunday shifts. Enter the inspection in the electronic work order.

Require 12 first-off units after weekend setup, 100% torque verification on first 30 units after maintenance restart, and quality signoff before remaining units are released. Link the signed customer quality amendment to the order record before production starts.
